purpose: 3D art direction reference images; not mesh assets or Unity screenshots

images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: art direction reference for a Unity URP Mars survival game, landscape concept render.
Primary request: Create one beautiful, coherent low-poly flat-shaded 3D game scene showing a small human survival outpost on Mars at dusty sunset. It must look buildable from very simple game meshes, not like a painting, miniature toy photograph, or a photoreal environment.
Scene: continuous open-world terracotta terrain with large visible triangular flat faces, a broad crater ridge and a few chunky low-subdivision icosphere rocks. Terrain extends to a fog-softened horizon, not a floating diorama or tile. Foreground: one small readable astronaut with an angular suit, a muted clay-colored helmet and dark purple opaque visor, looking toward home. Midground: a simple low-poly habitat made of chunky octagonal modules with flat faces and hard edges; beside it a low horizontal storm shelter partly buried in a regolith berm. Two orderly rows of broad simple deep-purple solar panels tilted on solid pedestals, adjacent stacked battery cabinets with geometric orange charge bars. A compact angular six-wheeled exploration rover and a three-legged science sensor mark the route. An enclosed greenhouse module has one small architectural cutaway side revealing muted olive crops in raised beds; remaining walls and roof are opaque matte faceted panels. The cutaway is a presentation convention, not open-air farming. All structures are modest, practical and consistent.
Composition: wide landscape image, clear spatial hierarchy, astronaut foreground, outpost midground, navigable valley and crater distant. Elevated third-person game camera. No text, no UI, no logos, no diagram labels.
Geometry: very low polygon counts, visibly faceted hard normals on ALL meshes, 6-8 sided cylinders only, boxy equipment, icosphere rocks with very few faces. No smoothing, no bevel-heavy greebles, no rounded smooth helmets, no realistic rocks.
Materials/textures: all object surfaces entirely solid-color diffuse matte materials or vertex colors; absolutely no image textures, no dirt maps, no normal maps, no grain, no patterns on solar panels, no specular reflections, no glossy glass or metallic shine.
Color palette: exactly these eight base material colors across the scene: terracotta #B96D55, dusty rose #C78D87, muted olive #7D8865, warm orange #E6A06E, deep purple #40334F, pale pink #E9B9BC, mauve #806886, clay sand #D8AC8F. Light and shadow may vary their values. No white, black, blue, cyan, neon, or saturated primaries.
Lighting: one warm orange-pink directional sun about 20 degrees above the horizon, soft long shadows with deep purple ambient fill. Gradient sky orange at horizon through pale pink to muted purple overhead. Light pink-purple distance fog. Gentle warm grading, barely perceptible bloom and a subtle vignette. No visible lens effects or extra lights.
Avoid: photorealism, PBR, high-poly geometry, textured surfaces, brush strokes, grass or alien plants outdoors, buildings that resemble cities, flying vehicles, explosions, lightning, excessive glowing elements.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: six-panel 3D model reference sheet for the same Unity Mars survival game as the supplied image.
Input image: use the supplied Mars outpost scene only as a style, shape, palette and lighting reference. Create a NEW reference sheet rather than modifying the scene.
Primary request: A polished landscape reference sheet arranged in a clean 3-column by 2-row grid, six evenly sized panels. All subjects are clearly 3D flat-shaded low-poly objects shown at the same three-quarter isometric angle on a simple matte dusty-pink floor. No scenery painted on the models. The six groups must look like models that belong in the supplied outpost. Panel headings small, crisp, deep purple, exactly as specified. Leave breathing room and do not crop objects.
Panel 1 heading "HEALTH": a chunky raised hydroponic crop tray with simple angular muted-olive leaves, beside a small 6-sided oxygen recycler with two faceted canisters and a very simple boxy exercise bicycle, matte pale clay and dusty rose.
Panel 2 heading "SOLAR": two upgrade states, one broad plain deep-purple solar slab on a simple pedestal, and beside it a slightly wider two-panel version on a sturdy pedestal. Solid flat panel surfaces, NO cell texture, NO grid, NO blue, NO shine.
Panel 3 heading "PROTECTION": two upgrade states, a modest angular octagonal shelter beside a more protected low broad shelter sunk into a terracotta regolith berm. Geometric orange doors. Simple silhouettes.
Panel 4 heading "STORAGE": two upgrade states, a single short deep-purple battery cabinet with three solid orange charge bars, beside a taller joined pair with visible side cooling fins made of simple solid blocks. Matte materials.
Panel 5 heading "EXPLORATION": an angular compact six-wheeled rover with low-sided polygon wheels, a chunky field sample case and a three-legged survey beacon. Plain orange identification plates, no text on the objects.
Panel 6 heading "SURVIVAL": one upright low-poly astronaut with hard faceted angular helmet and opaque purple visor, a small medical case with a geometric embossed plus in clay sand color, one faceted water canister and one geometric food container. Practical human survival props.
Geometry: visibly hard normals and flat shading on ALL faces. Very low triangle counts, 6-8 sided cylinders only, no smooth rounded surfaces, no decorative greebles. Strong identifiable silhouettes.
Materials: only solid diffuse colors or vertex colors. NO image textures, NO atlas, NO noise, NO dirt, NO metallic shine, NO glass reflections, NO specular highlights, NO emissive glow.
Use only eight base colors: terracotta #B96D55, dusty rose #C78D87, muted olive #7D8865, warm orange #E6A06E, deep purple #40334F, pale pink #E9B9BC, mauve #806886, clay sand #D8AC8F. No white black blue cyan or saturated primaries. Lighting may shade these colors.
Lighting: one low warm orange-pink directional light, about 20 degrees elevation, long soft purple shadows, mild warm grading. Very subtle ambient fill. No additional colored lights.
Only text is the six exact headings. No logo, watermark, wireframe, measurements or technical annotations. This is a 3D game model reference sheet, not 2D icons, not a painting, not photographic miniatures.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: four-panel weather and event art-direction reference sheet for a Unity URP Mars survival game.
Input image: the supplied Mars outpost render is the canonical reference for palette, exact low-poly modeling style and outpost design. Create a NEW comparison sheet.
Primary request: A landscape 2-by-2 comparison sheet. Show the SAME simple Martian outpost, same camera and same object positions in all four panels, under four survival event conditions. Each panel is a complete 3D rendered game scene with a continuous ground plane and a distant crater ridge. Keep objects very simple, large, low-poly and easily identifiable. The outpost consists of a faceted pink octagonal habitat, a low terracotta buried storm shelter, two dark-purple solar slabs on pedestals, a purple battery cabinet, and one small angular astronaut moving toward the shelter. Fine even pale pink gutters between panels; headings in deep purple on small pale pink strips at the top. No other UI or text.
Top left heading exactly "DUSTSTORM": the entire scene is dusty terracotta and rose with gentle bands of low-poly opaque dust-cloud volumes crossing the foreground. Nearby solar slabs and shelter stay legible, distant crater partly fades into rose fog. Do not use realistic smoke texture, swirly painted clouds or particle-sprite effects.
Top right heading exactly "SOLAR ALERT": ordinary warm orange-pink sunset sky, low warm sunlight and long purple shadows. The astronaut is approaching the shelter. A simple solid matte orange triangular warning plate on a short post beside the shelter communicates the alert. No visible radiation beams, no force field, no aurora, no lightning, no magical glow, no flare explosion in the sky.
Bottom left heading exactly "HOT AFTERNOON": the same environment in warmer orange and dusty rose lighting with pale pink distant haze. Solar panels remain plain matte purple; the shelter is recognizable. Convey dry heat with warm color balance only, no fire, rain, lightning, mirage distortion or excessive bloom.
Bottom right heading exactly "COLD NIGHT": the same forms in a restrained low-light mauve and purple treatment, a dark muted purple sky blending to dusty rose at the horizon. Maintain readable pink habitat faces and a clay-orange door. Very soft directional light and purple ambient fill, no extra lamps, no cyan, no blue, no frost texture or glowing objects. Keep enough exposure to inspect the meshes.
All geometry MUST have hard normals, pronounced large flat faces and very low triangle counts. Cylinders 6-8 sides only, no smooth surfaces, no high-poly details. All surfaces use only matte solid diffuse material colors or vertex colors; absolutely no texture images, dirt maps, noise, specular reflections or glass.
Only eight base colors across all panels: terracotta #B96D55, dusty rose #C78D87, muted olive #7D8865, warm orange #E6A06E, deep purple #40334F, pale pink #E9B9BC, mauve #806886, clay sand #D8AC8F. Shading and sky gradients can vary their values. No saturated primaries, white, black or neon.
One directional light roughly 20 degrees elevation for the warm states, soft shadows tinted purple. Light fog, mild warm grade, barely perceptible bloom and vignette. This is 3D game concept art with strong silhouettes, not flat 2D illustration or photoreal miniature photography.
Only text is the four exact headings. No logos, watermarks or other annotations.
